title: tridophyllum pentandrum
intro: Tridophyllum pentandrum, commonly known as the Pentaphragma, is a plant species within the Pentaphragmaceae family. It is a flowering plant known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tridophyllum pentandrum include reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity, which can be beneficial for wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents present in Tridophyllum pentandrum include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
